messages:
camila.reyes: Hey team — quick heads up, All‑hands is starting in 20. Recorder in PodRoom A is showing intermittent audio dropouts on the preview. Can someone triage?
ops-bot: Deploy reminder: live-stream job #ah-1768 scheduled at 1768888100.
alisha.patel: On it. Checking PodRoom A now — seeing audio level but occasional mute spikes. Might be the XLR snake.
matt.j: If it's hardware, let's flip to PodRoom B as fallback. PodRoom B has the local recorder and HDMI feed to OBS.
kevin.liu: I can swap feeds in 10. If we switch, need to notify hosts to reconnect their lavs to PodRoom B.
camila.reyes: Hosts are on stage. How long to swap? We can't delay the Q&A too much.
alisha.patel: I can patch a temporary loopback and keep the recorder running while Kevin swaps. That should avoid a full 10m delay — maybe 3m.
media-team: @camila.reyes please confirm you want the swap now. Also, captions are tied to the PodRoom A stream; will need to reconnect the captioner to B.
camila.reyes: Do it. Prioritize stable audio > captions for first 2m. We'll catch up captions once the feed is stable.
kevin.liu: Starting swap. Quick checklist: 1) reroute HDMI to B, 2) switch OBS scene to PodRoomB, 3) confirm NDI source.
matt.j: FYI using this command on the switch box: `ssh switchbox 'route hdmi --from podA --to podB'` — that'll do the heavy lift.
alisha.patel: Loopback patched, recorder still writing local file. Monitoring levels.
ops-bot: Incident marker created: #AH-AUDIO-1768888001. Notifying eng-oncall.
camila.reyes: @ceo_nick — we'll run ~2min mute during the swap. Heads-up for leaders in case Q&A begins early.
ceo_nick: Thanks for the heads-up. We'll hold on questions until you call it. No need to surface the swap to the org.
media-team: Captioner reconnected to PodRoom B, latency ~5s. Captions will resume once streaming buffer refills.
kevin.liu: Swap complete. OBS scene now PodRoomB. Recording checksum OK.
matt.j: Doing a quick test clip to confirm audio sync: `ffmpeg -f alsa -i hw:PodB -t 10 test_clip.wav`
alisha.patel: Test clip clean, no dropouts. Levels good.
camila.reyes: Perfect. Restarting live stream in 30s. Q&A goes live once captions catch up.
media-team: Caption lag cleared. :white_check_mark:
camila.reyes: Thanks everyone. Follow-ups for leadership Q&A: 1) Nick to address Dedicated-region timelines (2m), 2) Product to clarify rollout plan for Optimize features (3m). Please post succinct bullets to #product afterwards.
kevin.liu: Filing a short postmortem in incidents with cause: flaky XLR snake, mitigation: patch loopback + PodRoom B fallback.
alisha.patel: Adding action item: replace snake and add spare patch cable to PodRoom A kit.
camila.reyes: Great. Reopening thread for any follow-ups after the all-hands. :thumbsup:
